$description: Instagram colour rules for Scaalus. Moods come from moods/*.json; this file only says which moods to favour and how gradients adapt to each format.

theme-mix.note: Instagram rewards stop-the-scroll contrast — lean dark, but keep the one-dark-one-light rhythm in system.json.

formats.name: Story / reel cover
formats.calm-zones: Top 250 px and bottom 340 px sit under Instagram's own white UI — keep them plain ground (no mass, no highlight, no glow peak) so the UI stays readable.

grid: Look at the last 9 posts before choosing: no two neighbours share a mood, and the grid alternates dark and light at least every 2 posts.
reels: Reel covers use the story format and the next mood in the rhythm. The 1:1 centre crop must still show the headline on ground, not on the colour mass.
